target.description: Research, compare and evaluate the next-generation Project Cockpit through browser-rendered experiments, preserve full decision history and exact implementation provenance, perform source-faithful holistic reintegration under deterministic gates, and evaluate unresolved whole-product interaction/presentation on the complete integrated Cockpit.

known_exposures: Specification 008 and Foundation 021 establish the promoted Cockpit architecture and professional product direction.
Accepted Phase-C mechanisms are bound to exact implementation provenance through the 23-entry manifest and remain protected by deterministic browser gates.
Quiet Graphite, Boxes/Text, A6 and Conversation coexistence remain the held Conversation direction.
The first holistic integration was rejected; Research 088 identified manual reimplementation from summaries as the fidelity failure mode.
Checkpoint 251 established source-faithful holistic reintegration as the protected whole-product substrate.
Research 092 and Research 093 preserve earlier direct-manipulation and architectural 3D rail candidates as historical evidence.
Research 094 tested a permanent resting angled rail and that treatment was later rejected for the current rail direction.
Checkpoint 255 flattened the current right rail and replaced the static Deep Dive compass with a live Project-Grid-derived topology instrument.
Research 096 identified the Conversation layout-level blind spot and Checkpoint 256 corrected visible WorkUnit separation with 16px list gap plus 6px top/bottom structural row padding.

Checkpoint 256 restored Fullscreen to the current flat rail, removed Expand selected WorkUnit and Hide project HUD from that rail candidate, and explicitly left current-process Focus unchanged because the project owner confirmed it was working correctly.

Checkpoint 257 made the plain cockpit-reintegration.html route canonical, isolated explicit edge/rail historical study routes, and used ?edge=none only as an internal earlier-shell regression substrate.
Workflow run 33236756483 passed the complete 68-test source-faithful Cockpit suite for the Checkpoint 257 canonical substrate.
The project owner then explicitly accepted the Checkpoint 256/257 corrected Cockpit for continuation.

Human review of the integrated co-present Conversation screenshot identified a new whole-product hierarchy problem: the wide Conversation surface plus permanent thread rail reads as a second complete application beside the Cockpit.

Research 079 and 081-086 preserve the prior Conversation architecture evidence; Research 086 explicitly leaves co-present split geometry, resizing and pane-collapse behavior open while holding Conversation semantics.

Research 097 introduces an opt-in Adaptive Conversation Dock candidate: full-focus retains the source-faithful persistent rail, while co-present uses a compact resizable right dock and invokes the same Boxes/Text rail through a Threads drawer.
Official VS Code and Notion product references were used only as external workbench-composition evidence, not as semantic authority for ADS.
The adaptive study is isolated behind ?conversation=adaptive-dock; the plain canonical Cockpit remains unchanged until human acceptance.

Workflow run 33238181528 passed the complete 71-test source-faithful Cockpit suite at implementation target 00957b684cbc57dad11561f7ed262faf1bba4383, including three new adaptive-dock isolation and state-preservation tests.
independence.notes: No Claude obligation is pending. The Checkpoint 256/257 visual gate is closed by explicit project-owner acceptance for continuation. The current gate is human whole-product review of the opt-in Adaptive Conversation Dock at ?conversation=adaptive-dock. The plain no-query Cockpit remains the accepted continuation substrate and is intentionally unchanged by the new candidate. Quiet Graphite, Boxes/Text, A6, Conversation scope/access/state-restoration semantics, current-process Focus and the live topology compass remain held. The complete browser gate passes 71/71 at implementation target 00957b684cbc57dad11561f7ed262faf1bba4383. Production /cockpit remains untouched.

last_transition.reason: The project owner accepted the Checkpoint 256/257 corrected Cockpit for continuation and identified the next whole-product problem: current co-present Conversation reads as a second full application beside the Cockpit. Research 097 introduces an isolated Adaptive Conversation Dock candidate that preserves held Conversation semantics while changing only co-present hierarchy/navigation persistence under a complete 71/71 deterministic gate.
